scope: Standing 1904 rectangular granite valve house on the subsidiary dam, with attached entry step and a short stretch of the adjoining original safety railing.
geometryBasis: Original mapped rectangular valve house way 448005770. Footway 1061013254 establishes the side used for access.
sectionBasis: Standing granite valve house with flat roof, plain window and door and original safety rail treatment. Original HKPD terrain samples establish the building approach.
limitations: The roof height, edge profile, door and window proportions, glazing and the short rail section are estimates based on the written descriptions. The exterior walls follow the original mapped rectangle.
The 5 m terrain supports approximate contact along the narrow dam path. The building has a terrain-following foundation below the estimated main floor.
The independent spillway dam and the remainder of the subsidiary dam are outside this small building model.
